d: Poland is mourning six people killed in a mass shooting in Kraków after the 24-year-old gunman died in hospital. The suspect, identified as Michał Oksiński, was shot and injured by police during Saturday's attack and later underwent multiple surgeries. Police said he drove into the city's historic main market square and opened fire randomly, killing four women and two men. Sixteen others, including two police officers, were injured.
